title_en: They Bound Marko with Red Straps
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional, tied to Easter customs in Struška Malesija per the source note. 'Мили вили' is my reading as a double endearment ('dear, good'); 'калдрми' I rendered as cobblestones.

lines.en: They bound Marko with red straps,

lines.cyr: и милно се молеше: - Мили вили Турци,
lines.lat: i milno se moleše: - Mili vili Turci,
lines.en: and tenderly begged: - Dear, good Turks,

lines.cyr: пуштете го Марка, за него давам
lines.lat: puštete go Marka, za nego davam
lines.en: release Marko, for him I give
a plough together with the oxen.

lines.cyr: по Марка одеше и милно се молеше:
lines.lat: po Marka odeše i milno se moleše:
lines.en: she went after Marko and tenderly begged:

lines.cyr: - Мили вили Турци, пуштете го Марка,
lines.lat: - Mili vili Turci, puštete go Marka,

lines.en: for Marko I give silver cobblestones.

lines.cyr: по Марка одеше, милно се молеше:
lines.lat: po Marka odeše, milno se moleše:
lines.en: she went after Marko, tenderly begged:

lines.cyr: - Мили вили Турци, пуштете го Марка,
lines.lat: - Mili vili Turci, puštete go Marka,

lines.en: for Marko I give forged belt buckles.
